note: Copy this file to relay-settings.json and change the values. projects_dir: the folder with your code repositories. worktrees_dir (optional): where workers work; without it, <projects_dir>\_worktrees\claude. owner_name (optional): your name for the relay's notes. worker_tools (optional): the AI tools that may run workers, from claude, codex, gemini and antigravity; without it, only claude. Codex, Gemini and Antigravity workers stay off until you add them. Gemini costs money for every run. Google's consumer terms may not allow running Antigravity CLI from other programs, and your Google account could be suspended or closed: read the relay README's part on Antigravity workers before you add antigravity. claude_exe, codex_exe, gemini_exe and antigravity_exe (optional): the full paths of those programs; without them, Claude Code's usual place, codex or gemini from your PATH, and %LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin\agy.exe or agy from your PATH. codex_exe is for the Codex wake and a Codex coordinator too, and gemini_exe is for a Gemini CLI coordinator too. start_requests (optional, true or false without quotes): whether the relay starts workers for the W<n>-start.md files that a coordinator writes; without it, they are on for a Codex or Gemini CLI coordinator and off for a Claude Code one. A coordinator in Codex or Gemini CLI is signed up with bridge-relay.ps1 -Enroll -Tool codex or -Tool gemini: read the relay README's part on it. While one is signed up, or start requests are on, or new agents are on, or an agent with the relay's rules is signed up, the relay stops when any of its own files changes, so stop the relay before you change this file. agent_tools (optional): the AI tools that may have mail agents, from codex, claude and gemini; without it, codex and claude. Gemini CLI agents cost money for every turn, so they stay off until you add gemini. allow_new_agents (optional, true or false without quotes; false unless you set it): true lets the planner, HQ's orchestrator and a Claude Code coordinator ask for new agents with agents\<name>.md files. Read the relay README's part on new agents first. Codex coordinator turns, Codex workers and Codex agents with a profile start Codex without your own config.toml and command rules, with no web search, and need a Codex command line from April 2026 or newer. antigravity_sandbox (optional, false unless you set it): true runs an Antigravity worker's commands in Antigravity CLI's terminal sandbox (--sandbox). Only for the Codex wake (bridge-relay.ps1 -EnrollCodex): codex_exec_args (optional) is a list of extra codex exec options, one per entry, such as ["--sandbox", "workspace-write"].
